# HubSpot Community

> > Global community forum for HubSpot users, developers, and partners covering CRM, Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, Service Hub, APIs, integrations, and inbound methodology.

HubSpot Community is a multilingual support and discussion platform serving users worldwide in English, German, Spanish, French, Japanese, and Portuguese. The community provides technical support for developers working with HubSpot APIs, OAuth, HubL, and integrations (Zapier, WordPress), as well as strategic guidance for marketing automation, workflows, lead scoring, and sales enablement.

## Key Topics

- HubSpot APIs & Integrations
- Marketing Hub & Workflows
- Sales Hub & CRM
- Service Hub & Customer Success
- Content Hub & Email Marketing
- HubL & HubDB
- OAuth & Webhooks
- Lead Capture & Forms
- Inbound Marketing & SEO
- Zapier & WordPress Integration
- JavaScript, Python, PHP SDKs
- GDPR Compliance
- Community Best Practices
- Product Updates & Beta Features

## Developer Resources & APIs

- [APIs & Integrations](https://community.hubspot.com/t5/APIs-Integrations/bd-p/integrations): Developer forum for HubSpot APIs, webhooks, OAuth and integrations

## Marketing & Content Hub

- [Marketing & Content Hub (German)](https://community.hubspot.com/t5/Marketing-Content-Hub/ct-p/marketing_hub_de): German forum for Marketing Hub, Content Hub and inbound methodology
- [Lead Capture Tools](https://community.hubspot.com/t5/Lead-Capture-Tools/bd-p/marketing_conversion): Forum for CTAs, forms and marketing conversion tools discussion
- [Lists, Lead Scoring & Workflows (Spanish)](https://community.hubspot.com/t5/Listas-calificaci%C3%B3n-de-leads-y/bd-p/list_lead_scoring_workflows_es): Spanish forum for lists, lead scoring and Marketing Hub workflows
- [Email Marketing (Japanese)](https://community.hubspot.com/t5/E%E3%83%A1%E3%83%BC%E3%83%AB%E3%83%9E%E3%83%BC%E3%82%B1%E3%83%86%E3%82%A3%E3%83%B3%E3%82%B0/bd-p/email_marketing_jp): Japanese email marketing forum for design, deliverability and reporting
- [Social Tools (Japanese)](https://community.hubspot.com/t5/%E3%82%BD%E3%83%BC%E3%82%B7%E3%83%A3%E3%83%AB%E3%83%84%E3%83%BC%E3%83%AB/bd-p/social_tools_jp): Japanese forum for social media publishing, monitoring and reporting

## Sales Hub & CRM

- [CRM & Sales Hub Tips (German)](https://community.hubspot.com/t5/CRM-Sales-Hub-Fragen-Tipps/bd-p/sales_tips_tricks_best_practices_de): German CRM and Sales Hub tips, tricks and best practices forum
- [Sales Strategy & Best Practices (French)](https://community.hubspot.com/t5/Strat%C3%A9gie-discussions-et/bd-p/strategie_discussions): French Sales Hub strategy discussions and best practices forum
- [Sales Enablement](https://community.hubspot.com/t5/Sales-Enablement/gh-p/study-group-sales-enablement): Sales leaders forum for team improvement and Sales Hub strategies

## Product Updates & Beta Features

- [Product Updates (German)](https://community.hubspot.com/t5/Produkt-Updates/bg-p/product_updates_de): German product updates and feature release announcements
- [Content Assistant Beta](https://community.hubspot.com/t5/Content-Assistant-Beta/gh-p/content-assistant-beta): Beta feedback forum for HubSpot Content Assistant AI features
